mapper.sql: SELECT s.id, s.swap_no, s.status AS statusCode, CASE s.status WHEN 1 THEN '待对方同意' WHEN 2 THEN '已同意待发货' WHEN 3 THEN '交换中' WHEN 4 THEN '已完成' WHEN 5 THEN '已取消' WHEN 6 THEN '已拒绝' END AS statusText, s.initiator_id AS initiatorId, COALESCE(iup.nickname, iu.username) AS initiatorName, s.receiver_id AS receiverId, COALESCE(rup.nickname, ru.username) AS receiverName, s.book_id AS bookId, ba.title AS bookTitle, ba.author AS bookAuthor, s.offer_book_id AS offerBookId, bb.title AS offerBookTitle, bb.author AS offerBookAuthor, s.message, s.initiator_ship_type AS initiatorShipTypeCode, CASE s.initiator_ship_type WHEN 1 THEN '邮寄' WHEN 2 THEN '自提' END AS initiatorShipType, s.receiver_ship_type AS receiverShipTypeCode, CASE s.receiver_ship_type WHEN 1 THEN '邮寄' WHEN 2 THEN '自提' END AS receiverShipType, ia.receiver_name AS initiatorReceiverName, ia.phone AS initiatorReceiverPhone, CONCAT(ia.province, ia.city, ia.district, ia.detail) AS initiatorReceiverAddress, ra.receiver_name AS receiverReceiverName, ra.phone AS receiverReceiverPhone, CONCAT(ra.province, ra.city, ra.district, ra.detail) AS receiverReceiverAddress, s.initiator_shipped_at, s.receiver_shipped_at, s.initiator_confirmed_at, s.receiver_confirmed_at, s.cancel_reason AS cancelReason, s.create_time, s.update_time FROM `swap` s JOIN book ba ON s.book_id = ba.id AND ba.deleted = 0 JOIN book bb ON s.offer_book_id = bb.id AND bb.deleted = 0 JOIN sys_user iu ON s.initiator_id = iu.id AND iu.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN user_profile iup ON iu.id = iup.user_id AND iup.deleted = 0 JOIN sys_user ru ON s.receiver_id = ru.id AND ru.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN user_profile rup ON ru.id = rup.user_id AND rup.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN address ia ON s.initiator_address_id = ia.id AND ia.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN address ra ON s.receiver_address_id = ra.id AND ra.deleted = 0 WHERE s.deleted = 0
